title: Complete Android Gallery controls and help
scope: Expose touch controls for every shared semantic scene action and make status, loading, errors and Info content derive from common metadata.
acceptance: Motor, steering, dump, release/restore, gravity, force, focus, pause and reset actions are reachable when declared by a scene.
Phone screenshots and accessibility checks show readable, nonduplicated user text without internal roadmap language.

history.reason: Android exposes every declared common semantic action with readable, accessible common-metadata status and help; Pixel 6/API 35 emulator evidence and Android/iPad compile gates pass.
